assessment: The case reports Premium share moving from 27% to 20%; absolute revenue, volume and retention remain unresolved.
limitation_or_rival: Organizer premise, not consumer observations.
decision_implication: Define comparable-period denominators and the sales bridge.

assessment: With a hypothetical comparable total rising from 100 to 135, a 20% share leaves Premium at 27, equal to the initial 27.
limitation_or_rival: Requires a revenue-share interpretation and comparable periods; not actual company growth.
decision_implication: Do not equate share decline with the same decline in revenue.

assessment: Case examples: Basic 190 g at Rp24,100; Sensitive Expert 100 g at Rp41,900 or promotional Rp23,500. Premium unit-price ratios are approximately 3.30 and 1.85.
limitation_or_rival: Illustrative SKU prices, not portfolio averages or manufacturer realization.
decision_implication: Separate checkout affordability from sustained unit cost.

assessment: An official Indomaret regional flyer advertises Sensitive Expert 100 g at Rp19,900 against Rp39,900 in June–July 2025.
limitation_or_rival: Specified edition and period; branch stock was not verified.
decision_implication: Narrow absence claims to exact-SKU and local replacement questions.

assessment: Current 100 g and 160 g Sensitive Expert offers and a 60 g minimarket catalogue listing exist.
limitation_or_rival: Current catalogue evidence; no verified Jakarta checkout stock.
decision_implication: Check awareness and access to existing packs before proposing a new one.

assessment: Beauty/fashion, professional support, self-check, ShadeScan, science explanation and sampling routes are documented.
limitation_or_rival: Existence is not effectiveness; current materials may postdate the case.
decision_implication: Specify the missing mechanism before proposing an existing type of execution.

assessment: A commenter contrasts parent-purchased Sensodyne at home with concern about paying 50k when living in a kos.
limitation_or_rival: Age, pack, actual paid price and next purchase are unknown; not a Pepsodent switch.
decision_implication: Ask who funded the last replacement and whether the payer changed.

assessment: A commenter reports parental limits on changing brands and dry/acid sensations with dark Pepsodent while a white product felt acceptable.
limitation_or_rival: Exact SKU, tier and clinical cause are unknown.
decision_implication: Separate authority, experience and money.

assessment: A commenter reports no perceived sensitivity relief with Pepsodent and improvement after returning to Sensodyne.
limitation_or_rival: Unspecified Pepsodent variant; no clinical comparison or Basic replacement sequence.
decision_implication: Probe the exact need, product, experience and next choice.

assessment: A commenter describes discomfort during daily whitening use and changing to ordinary toothpaste.
limitation_or_rival: Brand is unknown; symptoms are self-attributed and target eligibility is unverified.
decision_implication: Retain adverse experience as a rival to a pure-price explanation.

assessment: An Ultra White reviewer explicitly reports buying again because the product fits: beli lagi krn cocok.
limitation_or_rival: Paid price, age and the meaning of cocok are unknown; source date is unverified.
decision_implication: Recruit retained Premium countercases and ask what fit means.

assessment: A Sensodyne reviewer links experienced benefit with not wanting to change toothpaste.
limitation_or_rival: Competitor account; stated commitment is not longitudinal verified retention.
decision_implication: Challenge an inevitable stop-after-relief narrative.

assessment: A Sensodyne reviewer describes longstanding use, benefit and repeat ordering.
limitation_or_rival: Self-report; price and target age are unknown.
decision_implication: Examine why a benefit remains worth funding.

assessment: A longstanding Enzim user describes finding a TikTok bundle discount and valuing a comfortable low-foam experience.
limitation_or_rival: No verified paid-price sequence or causal promotion effect.
decision_implication: Do not classify promotion interest as weak loyalty.

assessment: An Enzim reviewer describes continued use because other toothpaste feels unpleasant, while requesting more promotions.
limitation_or_rival: Post-case context; reported mouth ulcers do not establish clinical cause.
decision_implication: Separate fit from funding and preferences for deals.

assessment: A reviewer expected a larger pack but received two small ones.
limitation_or_rival: Post-case example, not a general pack-perception rate.
decision_implication: Check what buyers notice about grams, count and duration.

assessment: An Enzim reviewer objects to a minimum checkout quantity of three while wanting to try other flavours.
limitation_or_rival: Single checkout report, not a verified market-wide policy.
decision_implication: Test basket constraints separately from unit price.

assessment: An Ultra White four-star review says the product has not been tried; a five-star review says results are not yet known.
limitation_or_rival: Selected examples, not a percentage estimate of satisfaction.
decision_implication: Read the prose before treating ratings as performance evidence.

assessment: One-star non-arrival, two-star slow delivery and three-star packing complaints concern fulfilment.
limitation_or_rival: Complaint truth is not independently verified.
decision_implication: Separate fulfilment from toothpaste experience.

assessment: After starting work, a writer reports changing from a censored Pepsodent name to a more expensive toothpaste and experiencing fewer mouth ulcers.
limitation_or_rival: Exact variant, target age and clinical cause are unknown; the brand name is censored.
decision_implication: Independence can enable uptrading as well as downtrading.

assessment: A writer reports months without an apparent difference but continues because the product feels comfortable and does not coincide with mouth ulcers.
limitation_or_rival: Missing parent-product context; not a Pepsodent performance claim.
decision_implication: Retain nonvisual value and counterexamples.

assessment: A writer reports running out, changing paste, perceiving colour return, and using the earlier product again.
limitation_or_rival: Unidentified product and unverified appearance effects.
decision_implication: Observe what happens afterward rather than assuming permanent abandonment.

assessment: A childhood Closeup request was refused; the writer later interprets the mother’s Ritadent choice as an attempt to spend less.
limitation_or_rival: Retrospective memory, not a current target switcher or a verified explanation from the payer.
decision_implication: Use as a household-role prompt, not a prevalence estimate.

assessment: Shared Systema use is described as partly motivated by the mother’s comfort with sensitivity.
limitation_or_rival: Not Pepsodent; age and payment are unverified.
decision_implication: Sharing can justify a specialist choice.

assessment: A Lazada account combines product fit, bundle savings and reported availability difficulty.
limitation_or_rival: Historical continuity of the listing title is uncertain; no target switch is verified.
decision_implication: Allow price, fit and access to interact.

assessment: A Lazada writer expects to keep trying until sensitivity resolves.
limitation_or_rival: Expectation or intention; subsequent stopping is unobserved.
decision_implication: Do not turn an expectation into actual discontinuation.

assessment: Selected reviews include favourable overall ratings without visible change, sensory appreciation and a positive whitening rival.
limitation_or_rival: Incentives, subjective outcomes, product and date limits apply.
decision_implication: Ask what counts as success and what was actually purchased next.

assessment: Choice-overload meta-analyses identify heterogeneity and moderators.
limitation_or_rival: Mostly abstract-level appraisal; not a local causal estimate.
decision_implication: Observe actual comparison before prescribing fewer SKUs.

assessment: Cohort composition and new-versus-established customer results challenge universal discount pessimism.
limitation_or_rival: Different categories and methods; not transferable toothpaste effect sizes.
decision_implication: Compare cohorts, timing, quantity and the counterfactual.

assessment: A formulation trial separates sensory ratings from measured plaque and gingival endpoints.
limitation_or_rival: Formulations differ beyond SLS; funding and population limits apply.
decision_implication: Do not equate foam or mint with clinical cleaning.

assessment: An exploratory episodic CSPS study does not establish inevitable rapid relapse.
limitation_or_rival: Limited improvements, power and funding caveats; not a buyer-retention study.
decision_implication: Investigate behaviour without inventing clinical dependence.
